study type: Retrospective analysis of vital statistics data
exposure: maternal sociodemographic characteristics (region, age, marital status, nationality)
cohort: Nearly 9.5 million births recorded in Japan's Vital Statistics data between 2012 and 2021 were included in the analysis.
finding: Non-institutional births were positively associated with neonatal and infant mortality, irrespective of the presence of a physician or midwife.
